families.rule: Only fixed, versioned test suites may emit PASS evidence; arbitrary commands are forbidden.
A requirement needs an exact task-specific behavioral suite or a curated deterministic database/runtime recipe before evidence can be emitted.
Contracts are verified structurally from versioned repository artifacts, never by keyword presence.
Scanners must enumerate the inspected surface, fail closed, and never emit discovered secret values.
External approval cannot be synthesized by CI. The producer may ingest a correlated authenticated receipt only after the required authority acts.
